name: Gorilla Climb
summary:
Gorilla Climb is a heart-pounding VR parkour experience where you move like a true beast. Forget joysticks and buttons—every motion is powered by your own hands. Grip, swing, vault, and launch yourself through towering obstacles as you channel your inner gorilla. Physics-based movement makes every climb feel raw and exhilarating, demanding skill, timing, and endurance.
